patterns.name: Circle loop — 无障碍转圈
patterns.description: Mario circles in place on flat ground, cliff avoidance blocking forward movement.
patterns.diagnosis: Terrain classifier false-positive 'cliff'; cliff avoidance overrides straight-forward escape.
patterns.threshold_justification: wall_score<0.1=flat terrain, asymmetry<0.06=symmetrical movement (tuned from 0.05 based on real measured values), stuck>120s=abnormal duration, ground_angle>0.3=not a cliff edge

patterns.name: Ramp trap — 斜坡上无法脱困
patterns.description: Mario stuck on a ramp, suppression blocks turning.
patterns.diagnosis: Ramp suppression blocks turning; Mario stays on slope.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: Add ramp escape override when stuck >60s on slope
# File: fly64/fly64/main.py
# Add after slope detection:
if ramp_score > 0.5 and stuck_duration > 60:
    control.x = rng.integers(60, 80) * (-1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else 1)
    control.y = 40
patterns.threshold_justification: ramp_score>0.5=strong slope signal, stuck>180s=3min threshold, position_unchanged=no progress despite effort

patterns.name: Reflex cooldown — 冷却期内无效 escape (adaptive cooldown)
patterns.description: Reflex correctly detects anomaly but fixed cooldown prevents re-trigger during prolonged stuck. Cooldown should adapt to how long the agent has been stuck.
patterns.diagnosis: Adaptive cooldown already exists (memory.py _start_reflex, EVO R6). The finding means the reflex is NOT being (re)triggered at all during prolonged stuck: the anomaly detector sees the state but ReflexController's trigger gate (hysteresis / cooldown map / aggressive factor) never fires a new reflex. Investigate the trigger path, not the cooldown value.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: Investigate reflex re-trigger gate, not cooldown
# File: fly64/fly64/memory.py
# In the ReflexController update/check path: log why a trigger candidate
# is rejected (cooldown remaining, hysteresis, aggressive factor).
# If cooldown is the blocker, tune _aggressive_cooldown_factor or the
# adaptive floor (max(0.25, 1.0 - stuck/120)) — do NOT reintroduce a
# fixed cooldown.
patterns.threshold_justification: anomaly_state_not_idle=anomaly active, reflex_active=False=cooldown period, stuck>60s=1min without effective escape; adaptive cooldown formula derived from stuck_duration to allow more frequent reflex firings as stuck persists

patterns.name: Coverage stagnation — 覆盖率长期不增长
patterns.description: Mario trapped in small area; exploration strategy insufficient.
patterns.diagnosis: Mario trapped in small area; exploration strategy insufficient.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: Trigger forced_bold_explore immediately when coverage stagnant
# File: fly64/fly64/main.py
# Add before normal escape:
if coverage_stagnant_120s and visited_cells < 50:
    forced_bold_explore = True
patterns.threshold_justification: coverage_stagnant_120s=no new cells in 2min, visited_cells<50=very small explored area

patterns.name: Below ground stuck — Y坐标异常导致无法移动
patterns.description: Mario is below normal ground level (Y<50) but above the -100 fallen threshold, so fallen anomaly doesn't trigger. Mario cannot move properly at this height and sits idle.
patterns.contradiction: pos_y=-35 is clearly below ground (normal=120) but fallen threshold is Y<-100
patterns.diagnosis: Fallen detection threshold (Y<-100) is too permissive. SM64 normal ground is Y=120. Y<50 already indicates below-ground (void/water). Fix: change fallen threshold from Y<-100 to Y<50.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: Lower fallen detection threshold from -100 to 50
# File: fly64/fly64/memory.py
# In MotionStateDetector and MemoryController:
# CHANGE:
#   fallen = pos_y < -100 or pos_y > 1000
# TO:
#   fallen = pos_y < 50 or pos_y > 1000
# SM64 ground level is Y=120; any Y<50 means Mario is below ground surface.
patterns.threshold_justification: pos_y between -99 and 49=abnormal height (SM64 ground=120), stuck>30s=stuck in place, control_magnitude<10=no effective movement; the -100 fallen threshold was designed for extreme falls but misses partial falls into void/water at Y=-30 to Y=-80

patterns.name: Fallen recovery stuck — 跌落恢复循环无效
patterns.description: Agent is in fallen anomaly state and recovery cycles (jump+burst+turn) are not making progress. The recovery stuck means the agent repeatedly attempts jump-forward-turn cycles but remains in the fallen state without escaping the fall zone.
patterns.diagnosis: The escape 5-phase state machine (escape_x / escape_toggle_timer) was deleted in P1 audit A3; fallen recovery now runs as: escape_jump_drive (jump-pool burst, main.py) + spontaneous alternation via reflex.bold_direction() (TurnAdaptation counter-drive in model.py). If recovery stalls, the jump-pool drive or the alternation sign memory is failing — investigate those paths, not symbolic control writes.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: Fallen recovery — audit jump drive + alternation paths
# Files: fly64/fly64/main.py, fly64/fly64/memory.py, fly64/fly64/model.py
# 1. main.py: verify model.escape_jump_drive is set True while memory_ctrl.fallen
#    and that model.step actually injects jump-pool current when the flag is on.
# 2. memory.py ReflexController.bold_direction(): verify _last_direction flips
#    each cycle (mirror alternation) and is not stuck at one sign.
# 3. model.py TurnAdaptation: verify counter_drive/breakout currents reach the
#    turn pools during fallen escape (no zero-current gate blocking them).
patterns.threshold_justification: anomaly_state='fallen'=agent detected in fall zone, stuck_duration>30s=persistent stuck despite recovery attempts; 30s allows ~15 recovery cycles before intervention

patterns.name: Suspended animation — 控制信号为零停止响应
patterns.description: All control signals are zero (x=0, y=0, jump=False) while stuck_duration is increasing. Mario is completely idle without any escape attempt.
patterns.diagnosis: Brain model is outputting zero control signals while Mario is not in an escape state. This could indicate a visual disconnection, bridge issue, or the model has entered a dead state.
patterns.fix_template:
# Investigate: All control signals zero while game state=1 neural control active
# Check: bridge connectivity, model.visual_connected flag, encode_retina() output
# Check: timeout recovery in main.py for visual disconnection
patterns.threshold_justification: control_x/y both zero=no movement, stuck>15s=not just startup transient, jump=False=no escape attempt; combined with seq advancing indicates brain is running but outputting zero

patterns.name: Wall corner — 视觉盲区：动作-效果失配卡角
patterns.description: Mario wedged in wall corner. Invisible to texture-based vision (static frame, symmetric walls, zero transients) — detected only via motor-vs-motion mismatch (corollary discharge comparator).
patterns.contradiction: visual signals (temporal=0, ON/OFF=0, asymmetry=0) are identical to standing still in open field
patterns.diagnosis: Visual causal chain has no action-effect comparator: 'stuck' is defined by commanded vs measured displacement (proprioception), which texture-based vision cannot supply. Fix: corollary-discharge comparator + reverse-out reflex.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: corollary discharge comparator (action-effect mismatch)
# File: fly64/fly64/main.py
# expected = control.y * 0.6; actual = pose displacement
# mismatch if expected>25 && moved<3 for >15 frames
# Reflex: reverse y=-50 + alternating turn to un-wedge
patterns.threshold_justification: expected>25 units/tick = meaningful forward command, moved<3 = static, >15 frames = not transient; reverse+turn physically un-wedges from 90-degree corners where asymmetry guidance is zero

patterns.name: Dopamine gain plateau — Learning saturation detected
patterns.description: Dopamine-gated gain has reached a maximum plateau without further improvement in error gradient. The plasticity proxy may be saturated — suggests exploring a new strategy or resetting gains.
patterns.diagnosis: Dopamine gain saturated at ceiling (>=2.0) while learning_progress (mean abs error gradient) stagnates below 0.05. The gain modulation cannot further improve motor adaptation — consider resetting gains or switching to a new exploration strategy.
patterns.fix_template:
# Reset dopamine gains to break plateau
# File: fly64/fly64/model.py
# model.dopamine_gain.reset_gains() to restart adaptation
patterns.threshold_justification: dopamine_gain_avg>=2.0=near ceiling (GAIN_MAX=2.5), learning_progress<0.05=minimal error gradient (converged), stuck>60s=sufficient run time

patterns.name: Cliff standoff — 悬崖边缘对峙驻留
patterns.description: Mario parks at a confirmed cliff edge: cliff reflex blocks forward, escape keeps re-approaching — standoff with near-zero net displacement instead of progressing along the edge.
patterns.contradiction: cliff avoidance is working (no falls) yet exploration stalls — protection has become paralysis
patterns.diagnosis: Head-on cliff approach loop: forward drive and cliff retreat cancel out. FailureMemory knows this cliff — the tangential detour current (FailureMemory → turn-pool injection) should route Mario ALONG the edge; if standoff persists, the tangent gate or its freshness sign is mis-firing.
patterns.fix_template:
# Cliff standoff — verify tangential detour injection
# File: fly64/fly64/main.py + fly64/fly64/model.py
# model.cliff_tangent_bias must be non-zero when failures.nearest_failure_vector(x,z) hits
# and model.step must inject it into turn pools before spike generation
patterns.threshold_justification: cliff_confirmed=multi-frame edge confirmed, standoff>20s = protection plateau (retreat+re-approach cycles), escape active = brain wants to move but cannot

patterns.name: Micro-loop weave — 原地编织（交替未产生位移）
patterns.description: TurnAdaptation alternation is active (heading oscillates) but the loop window is still near-fully revisits: the weave produces no net displacement.
patterns.diagnosis: Spontaneous alternation converts circling into weaving, but weave-in-place still means zero displacement. Check breakout_drive gain and forward-pool injection placement.
patterns.fix_template:
# Strengthen oscillation-to-forward breakthrough
# File: fly64/fly64/model.py
# TurnAdaptation.breakout_drive: raise breakout_gain (0.15 to 0.25)
patterns.threshold_justification: anomaly=micro_loop=detector-confirmed circling, loop_score>=0.8=window near-fully revisits, stuck>60s=sustained weave despite alternation

patterns.name: Micro-loop weave (signal-only) — 原地编织（行为信号判定，绕过 anomaly 分类器）
patterns.description: Same weave-in-place signature as micro_loop_weave but detected purely from behavioral signals, so it fires even when the brain's anomaly classifier still reports idle (classifier/behavior disagreement).
patterns.diagnosis: Behavioral weave signature (loop window near-fully revisits, escape active, stuck rising) without a detector-confirmed micro_loop state: the anomaly classifier and the behavior disagree. The weave is real — check breakout_drive gain and forward-pool injection placement.
patterns.fix_template:
# Strengthen oscillation-to-forward breakthrough
# File: fly64/fly64/model.py
# TurnAdaptation.breakout_drive: verify breakout_gain (0.25 since EVO R17 sync)
# is loaded and the breakout current reaches the forward pool pre-spike.
patterns.threshold_justification: loop_score>=0.95=window almost all revisits (weave is certain), escape_behavior=true=brain is trying to escape, stuck>45s=earlier than the detector-gated variant so the signal path can act first

patterns.name: MBON saturation — 蘑菇体输出饱和
patterns.description: A MBON channel is pinned near |1.0| (tanh ceiling) while circling persists: the KC-to-MBON weights for that column have run away. Homeostatic synaptic scaling should self-correct; persistent saturation means the scaling is not firing.
patterns.diagnosis: forward MBON saturated at ceiling while behaviour still loops. The built-in homeostatic synaptic scaling should shrink the column; persistent saturation indicates the guard is not triggering or dopamine keeps re-inflating it.
patterns.fix_template: # Verify homeostatic scaling in mushroom_body.py saturation guard

patterns.name: CPG primitive timeout — 运动原语超时熔断
patterns.description: A CPG motor primitive (longjump/backflip/groundpound) was aborted by the 2s circuit breaker, meaning the phase script wedged without producing its move.
patterns.contradiction: primitive requested but phase script exceeded MAX_PRIMITIVE_S without completing
patterns.diagnosis: Phase script duration or game physics state prevents completion (e.g. longjump requested while wedged against geometry); breaker fired and fell back to reflex cascade.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: shorten the {primitive} phase script or add a state precondition
# File: fly64/fly64/motor_primitives.py
# Adjust: PHASE_SCRIPTS[{primitive}] durations / STATE_PRECONDITIONS
patterns.threshold_justification: MAX_PRIMITIVE_S=2.0s breaker (v2.15.0); any timeout event means the scripted duration was exceeded, so a single occurrence is diagnosable

patterns.name: CPG primitive zero displacement — 原语执行后零位移
patterns.description: Primitive completed but 60s displacement stayed near zero (primitive_disp < 30u over consecutive completions) — the move executed physically but did not escape the trap.
patterns.contradiction: primitive applied valid button sequence yet displacement stayed at ramp-trap baseline (0u)
patterns.diagnosis: Wrong primitive for the terrain (e.g. longjump on a ledge edge) or Z/A pulse timing lost by the game; needs a different primitive or tighter phase timing.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: retune {primitive} gating or swap primitive for this scene profile
# File: fly64/fly64/main.py (gate conditions) / motor_primitives.py (script)
patterns.threshold_justification: EVO VerificationEngine effectiveness threshold score>=0.3 and reflex_ineffective uses 30u/60s (v2.x) — same 30u floor reused for primitive outcomes

patterns.name: MBON 学习方向错误 — 原语列权重持续下行
patterns.description: A primitive MBON column's scene-independent weight mean is falling over the collector window (>=8 samples, >=3 min span) while the primitive is being used — success dopamine is being swamped by concurrent setbacks or the sign path is inverted.
patterns.contradiction: primitive successes keep firing (cpg_completed rises) yet the corresponding column weight mean declines
patterns.diagnosis: Success-tick dopamine is swamped by concurrent behavioral setbacks (check completion-tick dopamine mean) or the add_primitive_outcome sign path is inverted. Fix: raise the success floor (model._success_pulse_floor) or verify dopamine sign at completion.
patterns.fix_template:
# Fix: raise the success dopamine floor / audit sign path
# File: fly64/fly64/model.py
# Symbol: _success_pulse_floor (currently 0.2) and add_primitive_outcome
patterns.threshold_justification: columns drift ~+0.002/min under healthy success shaping (M3.1 live data); a sustained -0.0005/min over >=3 min is a 4x-sign opposite trend and cannot arise from noise (delta quantisation 1e-5)
